nodes.label: Drive-first storage direction
nodes.rationale: The project has confirmed Google Drive as the normal location and an S3-compatible provider only as an outage fallback, with no application-managed duplicate copies.

nodes.label: Failure classification and single-location rules
nodes.rationale: A timeout does not prove a write failed, so routing must distinguish uncertainty from pre-write availability failure.

nodes.label: Configuration secret boundary
nodes.rationale: Checked-in JSON must contain ordinary settings only; actual credentials belong in ignored environment injection and no secret-reference field is allowed.

nodes.label: Durable documentation record
nodes.rationale: Each meaningful change must record decisions, behavior, actual checks, omissions, and next steps for future sessions.
